overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving its April 18 minutes on June 5, which was untimely. A joint meeting with the Finance Committee counted as a meeting for timeliness. No remedy was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not approve its April 18 meeting minutes within the later of 30 days or three meetings, as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the Board’s approval of the minutes of its April 18 meeting on June 5, which was its fifth meeting and more than 30 days thereafter, was untimely.
